name: cardwise-monorepo
description: CardWise - Smart Credit Card Recommendation Extension & Rewards Dashboard

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:extension && npm --workspace=dashboard test
scripts.build: npm --workspace=backend run build && npm --workspace=dashboard run build && npm run build:extension
